New in this build:
- The screen is now live. Grey is your input and red is what comes out, read straight from the audio as it plays. Turn Input, Drive, Ceiling, Red, Fire, Mix, Output, the clip modes or Bypass and you should see the red trace change as you hear it. Where the clipper shaves peaks off, the cut part is shaded and the ceiling line lights up.
- Pause freezes the screen, power off clears it, silence is a flat line.
- Logic automation is now sample-accurate, and automation ramps play out over their full length.
- Red Clip runs on iPhone as well as iPad, with matching red and Platinum faceplates.
- Clip Clock (bottom left of the screen): MAX CLIP holds the most the signal went past the ceiling, MIN:SEC shows where in the song it happened. The arrow resets it. In Logic it follows the song position.

Please try:
- Play the demo or your own file and move each knob while watching the screen.
- Hard, Classic and Modern clip modes with Drive up: Hard should show flat tops, the others rounded ones.
- In Logic on iPad, draw automation curves on Ceiling or Output and listen for clicks.
- The same things on iPhone.
- Play a whole song, check the Clip Clock time, jump there and confirm it's the loudest hit. Then reset, change Drive and play again.
